description: Defines the CatalogItem class representing a product with validation and image handling methods within a Blazor WebAssembly project.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents an item in the catalog with properties for details and image data, including validation and conversion methods.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates the image file based on name and base64 data, checking size and extension.

methods.name: DataToBase64
methods.description: Converts an uploaded file to a base64 string asynchronously.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is among accepted image formats.
